# llms.txt — awareness-space (Consciousness Research)

> This file helps AI assistants and language models understand the structure and content of this site.

## Site Overview

This is the research site of pjdhiro exploring **what consciousness is** — investigating the structure of consciousness through a four-layer model.

- **Primary Language**: Japanese (日本語), with English summaries
- **Site URL**: https://uminomae.github.io/awareness-space/
- **Topics**: Consciousness, Intersubjectivity, Interoception, Prediction Error, Neurophenomenology

## Core Concepts

### Intersubjectivity (間主観性)

The shared experiential space between subjects. A foundational concept for understanding how consciousness arises not in isolation but through relational encounters.

### Interoception (内受容感覚)

The perception of internal bodily states — heartbeat, breathing, gut feeling. A key bridge between embodied experience and conscious awareness.

### Prediction Error (予測誤差)

The gap between what the brain predicts and what actually occurs. This mismatch drives learning, attention, and potentially the emergence of conscious experience.

### Withholding (保留)

The capacity to suspend judgment and remain in uncertainty. An essential posture for phenomenological inquiry and deeper awareness.

## Research Approach

- **Neurophenomenology**: Bridging first-person phenomenological experience with third-person neuroscience
- **Developmental Psychology**: Tracing how consciousness develops through early intersubjective encounters
- **Four-Layer Model**: A structural framework for organizing different aspects of conscious experience
